reproducibility.claim: The fixture regenerates byte-for-byte from the commit it names as referenceCommit.
reproducibility.method: git worktree --detach at the referenceCommit, npm run baseline:generate, sha256 compared against the committed file.
reproducibility.note: The generator lands one commit before the fixture on purpose. That commit is red in isolation — the driver emits a field the then-committed fixture lacks, and compareCheckpoint compares key sets — which is why the pair is squash-merged as one change.
